Your questions,

What does on-page SEO include?

It includes unique titles and descriptions, a clear heading structure, useful service content, descriptive internal links, image descriptions, and structured information based on verified business details. Canonical URLs and a sitemap help search engines understand the pages you want indexed.

How is on-page SEO different from ongoing local SEO?

On-page SEO improves the website itself. Ongoing local SEO may also involve maintaining a Google Business Profile, earning genuine reviews and relevant links, publishing new material, and reviewing search performance. Those activities are not automatically included as an ongoing retainer.

How quickly will a new website appear in search?

Search engines need to discover and assess the published pages, and there is no guaranteed indexing or ranking timetable. Competition, relevance, site history, and other signals affect visibility. Search Console can help a verified owner check indexing and learn which searches bring visitors.
